name: Gakkou ni Ikou!! -Lose One's Heart-
original_name: 学校に行こう！！－lose one’s heart－
source:
Main character works for a personal computer division at work, but there are only enough devices for one third of workers, so protagonist is sent to the school with personal computers. He needs to prepare for qualification tests or he's going to be fired. It's a nice time to go to school again!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-january-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在个人电脑部门工作，但设备只够三分之一的员工使用，所以主角带着个人电脑被送到学校。他需要准备资格考试，否则他就会被解雇。又到了上学的好时机！

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-january-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
